author: Blizzard Entertainment
description:
The BlizzCon Digital Bundles have arrived! ✨

Choose from franchise-specific bundles for World of Warcraft, Overwatch, Diablo IV, Diablo Immortal, and Hearthstone—or go all in with the BlizzCon Ultimate Collection, featuring every bundle plus exclusive bonus rewards.

🎟️ Attending BlizzCon? The Ultimate Collection is included with your BlizzCon Pass. Link your Pass to your Battle.net account to claim your items.

Available now through September 28. 🔗 https://blizz.ly/3TtW7ru
